caseName: Converse v. Minnesota Thresher Mfg. Co.
caseNameFull: CONVERSE v. MINNESOTA THRESHER MFG. CO. SAME v. FIRST NATIONAL BANK OF SUFFIELD
syllabus: A judgment of the highest court of Connecticut,- involving the liability of stockholders under, provisions in the constitution of Minnesota; reyersed on the' authority of Bernheimer v. Converse, 206 U. S. 516.1
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF ERRORS OF CONNECTICUT.
attorneys: Mr. Wm. Waldo Hyde and Mr. Charles Welles Gross for plaintiff in error., No appearance, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Judgments reversed with costs on the authority of Bernheimer v. Converse, 206 U. S. 516, and cases remanded for further proceedings in conformity to law.
